data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin providing inline WebView, headless WebView, and in-app browser features.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to add fully-featured webviews inside their applications across multiple platforms. Supports advanced script injection, cookie management, navigation tracking, and session recording.
use_when: You need to display web pages directly inside your Flutter application UI.
You require background headless webview execution for tasks like network scraping or session handling.
You want cross-platform support for webviews across mobile, desktop, and web.
avoid_when: You are using Flutter 3.47.x on iOS and cannot work around platform-view rendering layer issues.
Your project only needs to open external URLs in the device's default browser and doesn't require an embedded view.
strengths: Rich cross-platform support including mobile, desktop, and web.
Comprehensive feature set including headless webviews, cookies, and user scripts.
Includes helpful utility modules like NavigationTracker and Session Recipe.
weaknesses: Platform views on specific Flutter stable lines (like iOS 3.47.x) may experience rendering layer confusion issues.
Requires platform-specific runtime dependencies on Windows (WebView2 Runtime) and Linux (WebKitGTK).
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum platform versions (Android API 24+, iOS 15.0+, macOS 12.0+) and native runtimes like WebView2 on Windows or WebKitGTK on Linux.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter team package for basic embedded webview requirements without the extra community-driven extensions.
